remarks: Seller's loss is your gain. House has incredible potential! This wonderful Colonial is just waiting for you to call it home! As you enter you will be greeted by its charm, with it's open main level, great for entertaining, kitchen with stainless steel appliances and convenient first floor bedroom and powder bath. The large deck  and wonderful back yard will be a great place to enjoy time with your friends and family. Why wait? Come and take a tour today! This home is just waiting for you to bring your style and make it yours! As-is sale, looking for a quick close. Bring all offers.
